name: studyboard
description: StudyBoard - Online learning platform and educational workspace.

scripts.postinstall: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const f=path.join('node_modules','@mercuryworkshop','libcurl-transport','dist','index.js'); try{let c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(c.includes('redirect: \"manual\"')){c=c.replace(/redirect:\s*\"manual\"/g,'redirect: \"follow\"');fs.writeFileSync(f,c);console.log('Patched: redirect manual->follow');}}catch(e){}"
